name: Hotel Bunny
source:
You wake up next to a pretty bunny man. It's pretty clear what happened last night. Maybe a round 2 is in order.

[from [url=https://stickyswords.itch.io/hotel-bunny]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒來時，身邊躺著一個漂亮的兔男郎。昨晚發生了什麼，一目瞭然。說不定該來第二輪了。

［取自[url=https://stickyswords.itch.io/hotel-bunny]itch.io[/url]］
